name: Keeper Ansel
title: Keeper of the Waykeepers' Hall
examine: Lamp-oil and old paper. He walked the High Road three times end to end before his knees retired to the registry.
lines: Every lamp on every road is a promise somebody keeps. I keep two of them and a book.
The registry holds every name that walked north through our gate. Most came back. The hall's braziers burn for the rest.
The Waykeepers were founded on the mountain, but the order lives wherever a lamp does.
